key_points: Microchip acquired radiation‑hardened chip maker, enhancing specialty portfolio.
New touch‑control technology announced, detecting through thick covers/gloves.
Institutional sellers: Venture Visionary Partners and Fenimore Asset Management reported share sales.
Private Capital Advisors purchased ~273k shares, indicating contrasting buying interest.
Analysts note stock appears fully/overvalued relative to cash flow and GF value; chip sector facing risk‑off pressure.
